newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Third Russian MinFin due 1999 firm in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Third Russian MinFin due 1999 firm in thin trade.

text.p: The third tranche of Russian MinFin bonds firmed in quiet trading, with the market calm in line with U.S. Treasuries, dealers said on Wednesday.
"The market is quiet today, prices are changing 0.2 point at most on inactive speculative moves. MinFins are calm as are U.S. Treasuries," Avtobank dealer Pavel Afanasyev said.
Like other emerging debt, MinFins follow the U.S. Treasury bond prices.
A Deutsche Morhan Grenfell dealer said the third tranche was the most actively traded in thin trade.
